remarks: Nestled in the heart of East Norwalk, this charming colonial features a perfect blend of classic elegance and modern convenience. Situated on a peaceful cul-de-sac, this sun-drenched home features a spacious living room with a cozy fireplace, ideal for gatherings. The lower level provides a versatile space, perfect for a home office, playroom, or gym. The backyard is perfect for entertaining, with a private back deck and a cozy retreat for outdoor activities. Commuters will appreciate the home's proximity to major highways and a convenient sidewalk pathway leading to the train station, making it a commuter's dream location. Don't miss the opportunity to own this delightful colonial that seamlessly combines charm, space, and an unbeatable location. Please submit HIGHEST AND BEST by 12pm on 12/24.
